\item \textit{Notes:} Same draws and design as Table~\ref{tab:het_channels};
means over \(9\) draws of \(N=100{,}000\), with across-draw standard deviations of
\(\widehat\delta_0\) in parentheses. \(\delta^\star\) is the orthogonality point
\(-\operatorname{cov}(x,u)/\operatorname{var}(r)\), and \(\beta=2\). The FGLS
columns weight the first-stage regression of \(x\) on \(\mathbf s(\boldsymbol\delta)\)
by \(1/\widehat v_i\), where \(\widehat v\) is the fitted value of the squared OLS
first-stage residual on a quadratic in the exogenous control --- a
\emph{correctly specified} variance model in the control-driven rows. Weighting
the moment as well as the first stage gives \(\widehat\delta_0=1.001, 1.039, 1.099, 0.768, 0.746, 0.738\).
\(\Delta_{\mathbf V}\) is \eqref{eq:ols_fgls_gap} evaluated at
\(\widehat\delta_0\) with the same variance model (Remark~\ref{rem:delta_W}).
